english.notes:
From 20th October 2014, the power to issue a notice under section 92A of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 is no longer in force. The repeal does not, however, apply in relation to a notice issued under that section before that date or anything done in connection with such a notice. As such, this offence can still be committed in relation to a notice issued before 20th October 2014.

(i) Section 92B of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 makes provision for appeals against the service of litter clearing notices.
(ii) This offence was inserted by section 20 of the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005.
